header.tagline: Business Systems Developer | Epicor Integrations | C#/.NET Specialist

summary: Systems Developer with a core focus in C#/.NET and Epicor ERP environments. Experienced in building custom integrations, REST APIs, and SQL scripts to automate business processes. Passionate about writing clean, functional code and leveraging data to improve operational efficiency.

bullets: Cost Optimization: Engineered a PowerShell/JSON middleware to automate BarTender label population via Epicor Web APIs, saving $15,000 annually by eliminating redundant database replication services

System Integration: Partnered with Software Development to engineer Web API integrations between custom applications and Epicor Kinetic, automating Kanban, scrap/DMR processing, and shipping documentation.

Process Automation: Developed a modular C# library for Epicor API integrations to refactor and automate ToolBoss inventory synchronization; additionally automated monthly labor data imports using PowerShell and Epicor DMT to eliminate manual reconciliation errors and save data entry time.
Migrated legacy customizations to the Kinetic SaaS UI using Application Studio, developing custom event-driven UI layers to enhance user experience and workflow.
Team Documentation: Created a centralized documentation site and onboarding resources using MkDocs to streamline developer training and standardize departmental processes.
Spearheaded manufacturing capacity planning via custom Excel-based scheduling applications.
Translated business requirements into technical specs for ERP enhancements and KPI tracking.
Directed a $4.5M operational value stream, achieving throughput and quality improvements.
